title: C: memory, systems and reliable native programs
summary: A complete C17 route from first compilation through pointers, resource ownership, data structures, parsing, concurrency and maintainable systems projects. Safe counterexamples and checked programs make the language rules concrete.

lessons.title: Source, compilation, linking and checked execution
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement source, compilation, linking and checked execution.
lessons.lab: Store 2 plus 3 in an int.
lessons.verification: The stored value is 5. The checked amount is 24.

lessons.title: Integer ranges, signedness and floating approximation
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement integer ranges, signedness and floating approximation.
lessons.lab: Compute 7/2 and 7/2.0.
lessons.verification: The results are 3 and 3.5. The quotient is -3 and remainder -1.

lessons.title: Expressions, conversions and sequencing
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement expressions, conversions and sequencing.
lessons.lab: Compare 2+3*4 with (2+3)*4.
lessons.verification: The values are 14 and 20. The assignment changes the variable and equality tests it.

lessons.title: Branches, loops and invariants
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement branches, loops and invariants.
lessons.lab: Sum 2, 4 and 6 with a length-bounded loop.
lessons.verification: The result is 12. The reversed number is 321.

lessons.title: Functions, prototypes and output parameters
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement functions, prototypes and output parameters.
lessons.lab: Evaluate twice for 7 and 0.
lessons.verification: The results are 14 and 0. The operation rejects it and preserves output.

lessons.title: Arrays, bounds and element counts
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement arrays, bounds and element counts.
lessons.lab: Create a three-element array and calculate its count with sizeof.
lessons.verification: The count is 3. The original first element remains 1.

lessons.title: Strings, null terminators and output capacities
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement strings, null terminators and output capacities.
lessons.lab: Create the writable string cat.
lessons.verification: strlen is 3 while array size is 4. Its string length is zero.

lessons.title: Pointers, addresses and explicit mutation
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement pointers, addresses and explicit mutation.
lessons.lab: Increment integer 4 through its address.
lessons.verification: The caller value becomes 5. The values exchange positions.

lessons.title: Pointer arithmetic and bounded array views
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement pointer arithmetic and bounded array views.
lessons.lab: Read the second element through both forms.
lessons.verification: Both yield 4. The corresponding original element changes.

lessons.title: Structs, enums and tagged domain values
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement structs, enums and tagged domain values.
lessons.lab: Construct Point with x 2 and y 3.
lessons.verification: The field sum is 5. The validator rejects it.

lessons.title: Scope, storage duration and object lifetime
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement scope, storage duration and object lifetime.
lessons.lab: Declare an outer value 3 and a separate inner value 7.
lessons.verification: After the inner block, the outer remains 3. The result is the defined zero identity.

lessons.title: Const-correct views and mutation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement const-correct views and mutation boundaries.
lessons.lab: Observe a mutable integer through const int pointer.
lessons.verification: The read yields 4. The snapshot remains 2 while the view reads 5.

lessons.title: Preprocessing, macros and compile-time contracts
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement preprocessing, macros and compile-time contracts.
lessons.lab: Square the side-effect-free expression 2+3.
lessons.verification: The result is 25. The results are 0 and 9.

lessons.title: Parsing numbers with complete error evidence
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement parsing numbers with complete error evidence.
lessons.lab: Parse 42 into an output integer.
lessons.verification: Success is true and output is 42. Leading whitespace is accepted; trailing whitespace is rejected.

lessons.title: Dynamic allocation and single-owner release
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement dynamic allocation and single-owner release.
lessons.lab: Allocate three ints, assign 2, 4, 6 and sum them.
lessons.verification: The sum is 12 before release. The owner records absence afterward.

lessons.title: Reallocation and a checked dynamic vector
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement reallocation and a checked dynamic vector.
lessons.lab: Push 3 and 5 into a zero-initialized vector.
lessons.verification: Length is 2 and values are retained. The original value and length remain intact.

lessons.title: Ownership APIs, borrowing and independent clones
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement ownership apis, borrowing and independent clones.
lessons.lab: Create an owner for alpha.
lessons.verification: Length is 5 and content is alpha. Only the destination retains the allocation.

lessons.title: File streams, short operations and reliable closure
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement file streams, short operations and reliable closure.
lessons.lab: Write abc, rewind and read three bytes.
lessons.verification: Three bytes return and match abc. All three bytes survive, including the middle zero.

lessons.title: Binary formats, byte order and representation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement binary formats, byte order and representation boundaries.
lessons.lab: Encode 0x12345678 in big-endian order.
lessons.verification: The bytes are 12, 34, 56, 78 in hexadecimal. Version 1 and payload 7 are interpreted separately.

lessons.title: Function pointers, callbacks and comparator contracts
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement function pointers, callbacks and comparator contracts.
lessons.lab: Assign a doubling function and call it with 4.
lessons.verification: The result is 8. The result is zero and no element is accessed.

lessons.title: Linked lists and mutation-safe traversal
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement linked lists and mutation-safe traversal.
lessons.lab: Push 1 and then 2.
lessons.verification: The list order is 2 then 1. Its original order is restored.

lessons.title: Stacks, queues and ring-buffer invariants
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement stacks, queues and ring-buffer invariants.
lessons.lab: Enqueue 2 then 5 and dequeue twice.
lessons.verification: The values arrive as 2 then 5. The popped value is 5.

lessons.title: Hash tables, collisions and explicit occupancy
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement hash tables, collisions and explicit occupancy.
lessons.lab: Store key 1 with value 7.
lessons.verification: Lookup succeeds with 7. Replacement still succeeds.

lessons.title: Sorting, binary search and complexity evidence
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement sorting, binary search and complexity evidence.
lessons.lab: Search 2, 4, 6, 8 for target 5.
lessons.verification: The lower-bound index is 2. The guarded membership test succeeds.

lessons.title: Recursion, trees and depth budgets
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement recursion, trees and depth budgets.
lessons.lab: Sum a root 2 with children 1 and 3.
lessons.verification: The total is 6. Depth is 1 and sum is 7.

lessons.title: Bounded string builders and failure-atomic appends
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement bounded string builders and failure-atomic appends.
lessons.lab: Append red then space sky.
lessons.verification: The result is red sky with length 7. The exact result is a,b,c.

lessons.title: Testing, injected allocation failure and useful oracles
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement testing, injected allocation failure and useful oracles.
lessons.lab: Copy a tiny string using the working allocator.
lessons.verification: The output owns an equal string. Red remains different from red.

lessons.title: Headers, translation units and reproducible builds
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement headers, translation units and reproducible builds.
lessons.lab: Use the stats_sum prototype before its definition.
lessons.verification: Summing 2, 4, 6 returns 12. Both results equal 6.

lessons.title: Undefined behavior, aliasing and object representation
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement undefined behavior, aliasing and object representation.
lessons.lab: Copy a float into bytes and back into a float object.
lessons.verification: The restored value is 1.5. All bytes match exactly.

lessons.title: Sanitizers, debugger evidence and safe regressions
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement sanitizers, debugger evidence and safe regressions.
lessons.lab: Use a checked accessor on the final valid index.
lessons.verification: The value 6 is returned. Only zero is valid.

lessons.title: Checked arithmetic and allocation-size contracts
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement checked arithmetic and allocation-size contracts.
lessons.lab: Add 7 and 5 through the checked helper.
lessons.verification: The result is 12. The checked mathematical result is zero.

lessons.title: Generic byte APIs, alignment and element-size discipline
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement generic byte apis, alignment and element-size discipline.
lessons.lab: Exchange two ints using their exact object size.
lessons.verification: The values become 7 and 2. Both semantic fields match.

lessons.title: Flexible array members and single-allocation records
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement flexible array members and single-allocation records.
lessons.lab: Create a packet containing bytes 1, 2, 3.
lessons.verification: Length and all three bytes are retained. The owned packet retains its copied value.

lessons.title: POSIX descriptors, pipes and explicit endpoint closure
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement posix descriptors, pipes and explicit endpoint closure.
lessons.lab: Write abc, close the writer and read the bytes.
lessons.verification: Three bytes arrive unchanged. The tag is OK and one byte remains for the next read.

lessons.title: Signals, interruption and minimal handlers
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement signals, interruption and minimal handlers.
lessons.lab: Install the lesson handler for SIGINT and restore the previous disposition.
lessons.verification: Both operations succeed. Admission stops and unfinished work remains visible.

lessons.title: POSIX threads and joined object lifetimes
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement posix threads and joined object lifetimes.
lessons.lab: Start a thread squaring input 7 and join it.
lessons.verification: The retained result is 49. The second input produces its own output 16.

lessons.title: Mutexes, condition variables and predicate loops
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement mutexes, condition variables and predicate loops.
lessons.lab: Run four threads doing one hundred locked increments each.
lessons.verification: The final count is 400. Both totals are 10.

lessons.title: C11 atomics and release-acquire publication
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement c11 atomics and release-acquire publication.
lessons.lab: Add 3 to an atomic integer initially 2.
lessons.verification: The returned old value is 2 and current value is 5. The old state is false and the new state true.

lessons.title: Data layout, locality and honest performance experiments
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement data layout, locality and honest performance experiments.
lessons.lab: Sum x fields from three Point records.
lessons.verification: The result is 6. The total is 15 without a sixth access.

lessons.title: C ABI boundaries and foreign-function ownership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement c abi boundaries and foreign-function ownership.
lessons.lab: Copy hello into sufficient caller storage through a status API.
lessons.verification: The output is complete and required length is 5. The API succeeds and stores a terminator.

lessons.title: State-machine parsing and bounded input grammars
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement state-machine parsing and bounded input grammars.
lessons.lab: Parse 1,20,3 into capacity three.
lessons.verification: Three values are returned in order. Zero is valid; space-prefixed input is not.

lessons.title: Capstone: a validated data pipeline with explicit ownership
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement capstone: a validated data pipeline with explicit ownership.
lessons.lab: Process alpha,3 and beta,4.
lessons.verification: Two rows produce total 7. Only the corrected complete batch publishes total 8.
